description:
## Problem
PR #4537 (merge 8d8723e04f2d6739112dce55cc02da328f0cc9ae, fork 30.35.0.5) sends SQL that used to run untranslated or regex-patched through translate_sql_query or translate_ddl:
- Transaction Primitives operation scripts and their platform override scripts (BEGIN;, typed date literals, lower_series_selects output);
- Write Primitives series operations and SingleStore operations;
- TPC-DS maintenance statements on MySQL and SingleStore (SingleStore now gets `:> INT`);
- tuning metadata first-row query (T-SQL TOP) and metadata-table DDL (new T-SQL INFORMATION_SCHEMA/EXEC guard; explicit type maps for BigQuery and Snowflake; ClickHouse ENGINE layout);
- SingleStore vector-search queries (EUCLIDEAN_DISTANCE and a DOT_PRODUCT cosine formula);
- NYC Taxi DOW/EPOCH through fork generators (SingleStore EPOCH is now TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, b, a)).

Execution evidence exists only for DuckDB and SQLite: on 2026-11-25 Transaction Primitives and Write Primitives at SF0.01 gave pass/fail/skip counts identical to the pre-cutover merge 4bb8586ff99ad46d4259e8e6d35fb98a98a500ee, with zero failures. Every other target rests on unit and exact-text tests, and fork CI has no SingleStore engine. A statement that parses as text but fails or returns different rows on the engine would not have been caught.

## Change
For each platform below that has a local stack, run the listed benchmarks at SF0.01 on develop and on 4bb8586f (same image, same seed) and compare per-query outcomes. Fix any regression where the compatibility logic lives (fork rewrite or generator patch, adopted through the delivery workflow) or at the BenchBox call site through translate_sql_query/apply_rewrite.

| Platform | Benchmarks |
|---|---|
| PostgreSQL | transaction_primitives, write_primitives, tuning metadata path |
| Doris, StarRocks | transaction_primitives, write_primitives |
| SingleStore | transaction_primitives, write_primitives, TPC-DS maintenance, vector_search, nyctaxi |
| QuestDB | write_primitives (now() and series) |
| ClickHouse (local/server) | tuning metadata DDL |
| BigQuery, Snowflake, Synapse/Fabric | live cloud only (gate G2) |

## Decision gates
- G1: before running, record in context which matrix platforms have a local stack per the UAT framework docs (https://benchbox.dev/docs/operations/uat-framework.html). Platforms without one are listed as unverified with that reason; do not build new infrastructure here.
- G2: BigQuery, Snowflake and Synapse/Fabric need live-cloud runs. Run them only with owner approval given in the current task; otherwise they stay listed as unverified.
- G3: if a fix would change output beyond the owner decisions recorded on sqlglot-rewrites-into-fork (2026-11-25), stop and ask the owner.

## Verification rubric
Pass only if: every local platform in the matrix has a recorded before/after comparison (result JSON paths, image tags, counts); post-cutover failed counts are equal to or lower than the baseline and every changed per-query outcome is explained; each regression found has a merged fix and a clean re-run; unverified platforms are listed with the reason.

## Guardrails
- Heavy work only through lock-taking entry points or make heavy-run; check make heavy-status first; stop hand-started servers; never set lock, admission or watchdog overrides.
- BENCHBOX_OUTPUT_DIR under ~/Developer/benchmark_runs and --output ~/Developer/benchmark_runs/datagen; delete databases/datagen created under private roots.
- Local containers run on mocker, never in CI.
- No live cloud without owner approval (G2).
- No text replacement or per-platform SQL in benchbox/core (tests/unit/sql_compat/test_core_sql_text_rewrite.py); compatibility fixes go to the fork.
- Write work: linked worktree from make worktree-create, pinned human identity, no agent attribution, changelog fragment for user-facing fixes, make pr-preflight, make pr-open, make pr-arm.
